suppliers.subject: 30 ml cylindrical serum bottle + dropper closure — technical specification request
suppliers.body:
Hello,

BBROSE is specifying packaging for a premium 30 ml serum: a frosted cylindrical glass bottle with a rose-gold-appearance metallic dropper closure. We need manufacturer specification data.

Could you provide, for one exact product variant:

  - exact 30 ml cylindrical frosted-glass serum bottle SKU
  - product-variant page or catalogue reference
  - bottle dimensional drawing
  - bottle outside diameter
  - bottle height without closure
  - neck finish
  - neck outside diameter
  - brimful/overflow capacity
  - glass weight
  - compatible dropper closure SKU
  - closure technical drawing
  - collar outside diameter
  - collar visible height
  - dark outer component construction (bare rubber bulb / integral bulb-and-skirt / decorative outer cover / complete overcap / other)
  - pipette length
  - total assembled height
  - bottle material
  - closure materials
  - compatible decoration methods
  - CAD/PDF files
  - MOQ
  - sample availability
  - sample cost
  - lead time
  - country of manufacture

Please state clearly whether any total-height figure INCLUDES the closure.

A dimensional drawing or CAD file is the most useful single item. We are at the specification stage and are not placing an order or requesting a quotation at this time.

Thank you.
suppliers.rights_note: public contact endpoint only; no scraped private addresses; no credentials stored
